# Agent harness (Microsoft)

Microsoft says agent harness in the industry's sense of an [agent harness][industry.agent-harness]: "the software layer that runs an agent session" ([Understand agent harnesses][m4]). VS Code alone calls Copilot, Claude and Codex harnesses, which [Anthropic][anthropic.claude-code] and [OpenAI][openai.codex] name as both agent and harness; Microsoft Agent Framework's Harness Agent covers the harness and the agent together.

## Examples

- VS Code's agent harnesses: Copilot, Claude and Codex ([Build with agents][m3]).
- The Copilot SDK, "the same engine behind Copilot CLI", and Microsoft Agent Framework's Harness Agent ([Agent Framework overview][m5]).
